notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810016/239fd30f31cbfd2e80dea802ba86ce7e13ab5d27.png[/img]

UI Changes and Bug Fixes galore!

Here's what was changed in version 1.1:
[list]
[*] Redid the visuals for the options menu
[*] Fixed controller navigation in the options menu
[*] Added new setting for inverting vertical movement controls
[*] Added new button for deleting save data
[*] Updated the layout for each character page in the scrapbook
[*] Added captions to scrapbook stickers
[*] Locked stickers now display in black & white instead of being barely visible
[*] Added glow to stickers that are 'active' for the current game world
[*] Updated the game's taskbar icon
[*] Fixed the butterfly turning invisible during scene transitions
[/list]
